description: This file contains the implementation of the GrainDirectoryResolver class in the Orleans runtime, responsible for resolving grain directories based on grain types and properties.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryResolver
classes.description: Manages resolution of grain directories based on grain types and properties.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Returns the grain directory associated with the specified grain type.

methods.name: IsUsingDefaultDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the given grain type is using the default grain directory.

methods.name: GetGrainDirectoryPerType
methods.description: Internal method to get the grain directory for a specific grain type, falling back to default if none found.

methods.name: TryGetNonDefaultGrainDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a non-default grain directory based on grain properties and registered resolvers.
